sources.snippet: OmniVoice 🌍 OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it generates high-quality speech with superior inference speed, supporting voice cloning and voice design.

sources.title: OmniVoice: Free AI Voice Generator & Voice Cloning
sources.snippet: OmniVoice is a free, open-source AI voice generator that supports 646 languages. It converts text to natural-sounding speech, clones voices from a short audio sample (zero-shot Voice Cloning), or creates a voice from a text description alone (Voice Design).

sources.title: [2604.00688] OmniVoice: Towards Omnilingual Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech ...
sources.snippet: We present OmniVoice, a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model that scales to over 600 languages. At its core is a novel diffusion language model-style discrete non-autoregressive (NAR) architecture. sources.snippet: Clone any voice in seconds with OmniVoice. Upload a 3-25s audio sample — no training required. Zero-Shot Voice Cloning across 646 languages. Free and open source.
